datawebot-datawebot-mcp-datawebot.description: Ecommerce product data for AI agents through the datawebot MCP server. Use it to find products for sale across online stores around the world, from Amazon and Walmart to brand stores (title, price, shop, rating, review count, image), and to list one product's seller offers with direct shop links. Extraction Jobs for search, catalogue and product pages run on the same server. Searches, product reads and Jobs are paid in credits (200 free credits per account, then credit packs). Sign-in is free by email, with no card and no password. Do not use it for historical prices, guaranteed-current…
